resources.string: Press back again to close ELBAS · ለመዝጋት እንደገና ይጫኑ
Messages and calls when ELBAS is closed · ELBAS ሲዘጋም መልዕክትና ጥሪ

So your phone shows new messages with a sound and rings for calls even when ELBAS is closed, allow ELBAS: notifications, no battery limit, and full-screen calls. It takes a few taps.\n\nELBAS ሲዘጋም አዲስ መልዕክት በድምፅ እንዲያሳይ እና ጥሪ እንዲያስጠራ፣ ለELBAS ማሳወቂያዎችን፣ የባትሪ ገደብ ማንሳትን እና ሙሉ ስክሪን ጥሪን ይፍቀዱ።
Allow ELBAS to install the update, then come back · ዝማኔውን ለመጫን ELBAS ይፍቀዱ፣ ከዚያ ይመለሱ
Downloading the update… Android will ask you to install it · ዝማኔው እየወረደ ነው…
